description.value: Little Town Pizza is a family-owned pizzeria established in Chemainus in 2018, serving handcrafted pizzas from a menu of 45+ options including specialty pies, pasta, donairs, and wings. In August 2023 it joined the Roberts Street Pizza family, which has served Vancouver Island since 1997. A customer review on the business's own website highlights outdoor seating with large log picnic benches, suggesting a relaxed, casual stop well-suited to cyclists passing through Chemainus.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at littletownpizza.ca is live and detailed, confirming the business is operational with an active menu, online ordering, and contact pages. The contact page lists the Chemainus location as '9780 Willow Street, Chemainus, BC' with phone (250) 324-2242, which matches the OSM phone but conflicts with the OSM address of '9734 Chemainus Road'. The website confirms pickup and delivery service and lists several clearly meatless specialty pizzas by name, but contains no mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM lists '9734 Chemainus Road' but the business website contact page lists '9780 Willow Street, Chemainus, BC' for the Chemainus location. Website address used as primary value.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational pizzeria in Chemainus with an active website, confirmed menu, and online ordering — a clear food stop for touring cyclists on the Island.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists several meatless specialty pizzas by name: Euro Veggie (Artichokes, Onions, Tomatoes, Feta, Black Olives), The Red Green (Garlic, Spinach, Broccoli, Tomatoes, Red Onions, Red Peppers, Feta), Pestoganza (Pesto, Mushrooms, Spinach, Artichokes, Red Onions, Feta), California Classic (Pesto, Garlic, Sun-Dried Tomatoes, Onions, Zucchini, Pineapple, Parmesan). No explicit GF or vegan labels found on the site
